tips.text: Break Kril's pipes with explosive or high-burst weapons such as an Arca Plasmor, an Ignis aimed at the floor under him, or Valkyr slams.
Run it solo or in a quiet squad; squadmates who melee him or pull his aggro wreck his phases.
Kill Kril and Vor every run; each carries its own copy of the table, so a run is two rolls.
Avoid Cold procs, which lengthen his invulnerable windows, and Heat, which thaws him early.
Stay far enough that he does not swing, close enough that he does not just use the Gorgon.
Try Ivara with a Lanka from stealth and let trash mobs knock the pipes off.
Hit him in the window after the last pipe breaks to shorten phase two.
Expect Miter and Frost drops on most runs; only the Twin Gremlins Blueprint counts, and long miss streaks are normal at 1 in 6.
Start collecting Neurodes before the blueprint drops; they are the slow trickle.
The fight is the dislike, not the drop rate; once you know the pattern it takes about a minute.
Most players build it only for Mastery; it is mediocre next to other secondaries.
